Intro: You seem burdened. Is everything quite alright? I am here to listen.
Oh, you must forgive me. I run confessionals downtown. I suppose the work never leaves me, hm?
I came to indulge in a [DISH], if you're willing. But please, feel free to tell me anything you like.
Success: You are better than I. You heard my confessions without me saying a word. I am in your debt.
Fail: Do not fear. All you can do is work to overcome your burdens by moving forward. I wish you well.
Reject: Am I… not fit to hear people's worries? But I swore! I swore myself to being a guiding light!
